training: All arms start from SAME published fusion6/9/12 checkpoint. Seeds vary fine-tuning order/dropout, not original pretraining. Four epochs,32 updates/epoch,batch8,AdamW lr5e-5 wd1e-4,clip5. Fixed final epoch, no model selection.
parameter_policy: Public WavLM encoder frozen. Three fusion logits, LayerNorm/projection, original CNN-BiGRU and complete dual-resolution adapter ALL remain trainable.
old_only: Only256 memory recordings, rotating original/noise20dB/EQ views;128 updates.
new_only: Only256 target recordings, rotating white noise15dB/noise5dB by (global_index+epoch-1)%2;128 updates.
replay: Same target batches as new_only + same memory batches/views as old_only;0.25 new loss+0.75 old loss; weighting3:1, not literal batch count3:1; identical8+8 batches and compute to prior3:1; only learning rate reduced from1e-4 to5e-5;128 updates, extra old forward/backward computation. Not compute-matched.
source_data_note: All512 selected training recordings were part of original6345 training pool. Newness is channel condition, not unseen training content. Memory and target UIDs disjoint.

conditions.clean_full: All2484 dev recordings; source-regression check, historically used for source selection.
conditions.noise0: Same384 under untrained stronger0dB white noise.
conditions.lp2600: Same384 under unseen stronger lowpass, never in fine-tuning.

transforms: Causal sixth-order Butterworth lowpass; no group-delay correction; white noise normalized per-record RMS, fixed UID seed, no clipping/time change.
threshold_policy: Original checkpoint logit threshold fixed for EVERY model and EVERY condition. No recalibration, no eval/LPS access.
uncertainty: Report per-seed point preservation screen and paired UID bootstrap95% intervals. A point pass does not establish noninferiority; check lower event/frame bounds>=-0.5 and upper FPR bound<=0.5 separately.
inference: Frozen encoder shared across3 freshly evaluated backends; other controls reuse hash-verified saved predictions under identical data/conditions/threshold. generalization_claim: Training white noise15/5dB. Test interpolation10dB, extrapolation0dB and unseen spectral type pink10dB. Entire384 stress subset reused from previous exploratory pilot; not blind test. LP2600 checks retention. Synthetic noise is not real-world unseen corpus.
previous_control: Previous noise+3:1 replay, noise-only and old-only frozen predictions reused; fresh3:1 lr5e-5 starts from original. This lower learning rate selected after observing previous dev regression; not continuation from prior trained replay; exploratory follow-up, not blind confirmation.
